gen-fs-oswald-gf-hanken-grotesk: Oswald packs its rows tight and stands tall with a confident, display-sized punch, while Hanken Grotesk draws each word like bent wire. One shouts the point; the other explains it in sans.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-hubot-sans: Hubot Sans opens its e wide and keeps a contemporary face on every line. Oswald carries the strong heading above it, and the body text can be sized up a touch if it feels small.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: Easy to follow, with open apertures that never leave a letter guessing, this body text feels approachable from the first line. IBM Plex Sans Arabic sits beside Oswald's strong, tightly knit headings like a friendly voice answering a firm one.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanagar: Tightly knit rows give Oswald a confident, compressed look that announces itself immediately, even at a glance across the page. It hits hardest as a headline; IBM Plex Sans Devanagari lets its loose curves breathe.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew leaves the mouths of its s and c open and uncrowded, which gives each line a contemporary, approachable ease. Oswald earns its keep when it runs big and short.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Every curve in IBM Plex Sans JP ends in a clean, open gap. Over a longer passage that makes for a professional, approachable read, while Oswald's tightly knit rows stay confident up top.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Oswald's tightly knit rows give it a strong, confident stance. IBM Plex Sans KR leaves openness at every curve end, so a longer stretch of text moves along with a modern, unhurried feel.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Confident from the first glance, Oswald packs its text rows tightly, while IBM Plex Sans Thai bends its c into two ends that point apart like open pincers. The heading hits hard; the body modestly explains.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loop: Curves that refuse to close give IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped a clean, neutral reading feel that never feels cramped. Next to it, Oswald's tightly knit rows come across as the strong, confident voice.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-imprima: Smooth and tube-like, Imprima looks poured rather than drawn. Oswald's tightly knit, confident headings stand firm above its flared terminals, and the body's even stroke and crossbars let the text relax underneath.
